title: ‘If the bot gets it wrong, who’s liable?’ Retailers enter the unknown with AI shopping assistants on Black Friday
summary: Brands know use of agents such as Meta Muse is on the rise but are unlikely to hand them the keys to the shop Have you downloaded Meta’s AI assistant Muse or do you plan to? They promise to find the best Black Friday deals, source Christmas gifts and find the ingredients for a romantic dinner. This week’s UK launch of the Muse AI assistant by the owner of Facebook and Instagram promises to transform how we shop – and how retailers make money. Continue reading...

title: Natural England objected to a datacentre. Weeks later ministers threatened to abolish the agency
summary: Body urged Bristol city council to reject plan because of risk to nearby protected wildlife and habitats Natural England objected to the building of a large AI datacentre near Bristol weeks before the government threatened to abolish the independent environmental adviser. The nature adviser made a significant intervention to urge Bristol city council not to grant planning permission for a 40MW datacentre at Avonmouth, because of the threat to protected wildlife and habitats at one of the UK’s most important sites for migratory birds, which is within 600 metres of the site.
